article.headline: Okananwa, Thiero have double-doubles, No. 18 Maryland women rout Morgan State 109-39
article.description: — Oluchi Okananwa scored 20 points and grabbed 10 rebounds, Mimi Thiero had 14 and 12 and No. 18 Maryland coasted to a 109-39 win over Morgan State on Saturday.
article.linkText: Okananwa, Thiero have double-doubles, No. 18 Maryland women rout Morgan State 109-39

categories.description: Morgan State Lady Bears @ Maryland Terrapins

event.description: Morgan State Lady Bears @ Maryland Terrapins

keywords: Morgan State Lady Bears @ Maryland Terrapins
article.story: COLLEGE PARK, Md. -- — Oluchi Okananwa scored 20 points and grabbed 10 rebounds, Mimi Thiero had 14 and 12 and No. 18 Maryland coasted to a 109-39 win over Morgan State on Saturday. Rainey Welson added 18 points for the Terrapins (4-1), who took command with an 18-2 run in the first quarter and held the Bears scoreless in the second. Jordyn Jackson had 15, Addi Mack 12 and Trinity Jones 10. Maryland had a 62-27 rebounding advantage and shot 57.5% (48 of 80). Dru Carlton scored 17 points for the Bears (2-6), who had seven field goals through three quarters and made seven more, including all three of their 3-pointers, in the fourth quarter. They ended up at 23% (14 of 61), going 4 of 28 from 3-point range. Morgan State scored the last five points. Maryland's record for margin of victory is 74. Up next Morgan State: At VCU on Monday. Maryland: Home against Monmouth on Tuesday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full college basketball coverage here
